lead_raw_text:
The structure of Bi2Ag8Pt2Se20 (reduced formula Ag4PtSe10) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived coordination analysis shows Ag centers with 5 Se neighbors, Bi centers with 8 neighbors (4 Ag, 4 Se), and Pt centers with 4 Se neighbors, while Se adopts several environments including one tetrahedral motif. The geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions across all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between tetrahedral Se polyhedra, corner- and edge-sharing between 8-vertex Se polyhedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Bi and Se polyhedra.
